question: author, 2026-11-08: theory online, physical schools and hospitals used in rotation for practice only; trainees rotate across hospitals to learn with expert clinicians

published.label: Published plan: schools and teachers at most tripled (cap 3x), +10%/yr for 15 years

rotation_same_educators.label: Theory online, facilities in rotation, simulation for half of clinical hours; same educators

rotation_every_hospital_teaches.label: As above, and every hospital teaches: placements and preceptors grow with the workforce

rotation_every_hospital_exp15.label: As above, with +15%/yr expansion (faculties and trainers first, T-8.5)

rotation_every_hospital_exp15_retention2.label: As above, with exits 3% -> 2% a year (retention)

reading: with the same educators the cap rises only from 3x to about 3.3-4.5x because educators bind; the large gain comes when every hospital teaches, so that placements and preceptors grow with the workforce. Facilities stop being the limit; people who teach are.

evidence.lecture_space: theory online: lecture halls stop binding (set to 30x, i.e. never the smallest component). Blended learning vs traditional: knowledge SMD 0.81 (Liu 2016, 56 articles; 0.26 after trim-and-fill) and 1.07 (Vallee 2020, 56 studies) - as effective or better, heterogeneity high. VERIFIED (abstracts).
evidence.practice_facilities: skills laboratories and simulation centres used in rotation: occupancy from ~20% (Smart Space Forum / SmartViz analysis of 30+ UK universities, THE 23 Jul 2026, REPORTED) or 35% (Bristol target, unverified) to 60-70% with shifts and six or seven days a week. SYNTHETIC targets.
evidence.clinical_placements: simulation replaces 25% (low) or 50% (central, high) of clinical hours with no difference in outcomes (NCSBN National Simulation Study, 10 programmes, 666 students, randomised, VERIFIED_OFFICIAL) -> x1.33 / x2 placement capacity per student; high adds x1.5 for rotation across under-used hospitals and regions (SYNTHETIC). Evidence is for pre-licensure nursing; extension to doctors and midwives is an assumption.
evidence.educators: online theory frees 10 / 30 / 50% of educator time per student (one lecturer serves many; tutoring, assessment and supervision still scale with students). SYNTHETIC. Educators, clinical sites and preceptors are the barriers US nursing schools report (AACN, 15 Apr 2024: 65,766 qualified applications refused in 2023, VERIFIED_OFFICIAL).

limits: simulation evidence is for pre-licensure nursing at 50% of clinical hours; it is applied to all cadres
supervising trainees costs clinicians' time; the model does not subtract it from care delivered
children's schooling is NOT covered: school closures cost about 0.19 SD of learning (Di Pietro 2023, 39 studies, 19 countries, VERIFIED); online theory is for adult and professional education
trainees rotating across regions need housing, travel and language support, not modelled
